provenance.construction: Distance-amplified code: one [[4,2,2]] tensor-product amplification step (central three-term truncation of the chain-complex tensor product, arXiv:2609.37231 Eq. 1/Eq. 12-15) applied to the board's [[6,4,2]] entry, using a sparse independent-row presentation of its checks: n' = 4n + m_X + m_Z = 26, k' = 2k = 8, check weight w' = w+1 = 7. X/Z witnesses are the base witnesses tensored with the weight-2 [[4,2,2]] logical on the central register (weights 4/4); a 100000-trial fast-backend search (seed 5000) found nothing lighter (min weight 4). Base provenance: error-detecting CSS code (H_X = H_Z = the all-ones row on 6 qubits; reproduced from the Error Correction Zoo entry stab_6_4_2, https://errorcorrectionzoo.org/c/stab_6_4_2)
provenance.notes: Constructed and packaged with the Space Bunny Alpha 1.0 model.

contributed_by.method: Simulated annealing over site assignments on an integer grid with the repo's own research/local2d/fold_layout.search_layout (max-diameter objective, several bounding boxes and seeds); single layer at radius 4 tried first, then two layers at 7. Radius and per-site occupancy re-measured with the verifier's rule.
